title: Immunostaining of intact C. elegans using polyacrylamide embedding
protocol: Harvest ∼200–500 worms per immunostaining using S-buffer (or M9 buffer) in 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge for 90 s at 400 × g and then aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend in 1 ml of S-buffer (or M9 buffer).
Repeat steps for a total of 2 washes to remove residual bacteria.
After the second wash, aspirate the supernatant and add 500 μL of 60% isopropanol.
Fix for a minimum of 10 min.
Centrifuge for 90 s at 400 × g and then aspirate the supernatant.
Resuspend in 500 μL 0.5% PBS-T.
Repeat steps for a total of three washes with 0.5% PBS-T.
Aspirate the 0.5% PBS-T after the third wash, and then resuspend the worms in 1 ml 1× PBS for 10 min.
Centrifuge for 90 s at 400 × g and aspirate the supernatant.
Add 300 μL of freshly prepared monomer solution.
Incubate samples on a rocker or rotator at 4°C for at least an hour.
Wash the PTFE/Teflon slides with distilled water.
Wash the PTFE/Teflon slides with freshly made 70% ethanol.
Use compressed air to dry the slides by blowing the air directly on the slides for about a minute.
Incubate PTFE/Teflon slides in Sigmacote or Repel-Silane for 15 seconds at room temperature.
Air dry the slides at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Wash the slides with 70% ethanol.
Wash the slides with distilled water.
Air dry the slides at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Keep the dried slides in a closed box until needed.
Optional: Oven dry the slides for 1 hour at 65°C for a more durable coating.
Silanized slides can be stored at room temperature for up to 1 month.
Wash standard microscope slides with distilled water.
Wash the slides with freshly made 70% ethanol.
Add 50 μL of Bind-Silane to 50 mL of previously prepared Bind-Silane pre-solution.
Incubate the slides in the Bind-Silane working solution for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Air dry the slides at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Wash the slides with distilled water.
Use compressed air to dry the slides.
Allow the slides to air dry.
Centrifuge the worms that were rocking at 4°C for 90 seconds at 400 × g.
Aspirate the monomer solution from the centrifuged worms.
Activate the monomer solution by adding the appropriate amount of 10% APS and 10% TEMED.
Add 50 μL of activated monomer solution to the worms.
Resuspend the worms gently by pipetting up and down.
Place wet paper towels at the bottom of the vacuum chamber.
Place the platform in the chamber and your slide on top of the platform.
Place the dome on top to close the chamber.
Remove the plug from the valve.
Place the vacuum hose in the side opening and turn the vacuum on.
Turn the valve so that the arrows are pointing towards the opening where the hose was placed, the closed side, and the chamber.
Put the plug back in and leave it in this position for around a minute.
Turn the valve so the arrows are now pointing to the plug, the chamber, and the closed side.
Turn off the vacuum and remove it from the side.
Place the vacuum chamber in a 37°C incubator for 1 h.
Remove the sandwich from the chamber and place it on a clean workspace.
Carefully remove the Repel-Silane (PTFE) slide by lifting it using a razor blade.
Cut the gel with embedded worms into a rectangular shape estimated to fit tightly within the CultureWell silicon gasket.
Smooth all edges of the sample gel using a sharp razor blade.
Use a razor blade at a 45° angle to remove excess gel around the area of interest.
Clean the area around the sample gel thoroughly with a Kimwipe moistened in ethanol (200 proof).
Place the CultureWell silicon gasket around the sample, ensuring no air bubbles are created.
Remove and replace the gasket if bubbles occur during placement.
Use the back of the razor to press across the surface of the gasket to remove any bubbles that form.
Pipette 250 μL of 1× PBS into the well of the gasket.
Incubate for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the 1× PBS by placing the tip of the vacuum in the corner of the gasket.
Add 250 μL of 5% BME solution and incubate for 2 hours at 37°C in a humidified chamber.
Aspirate the BME solution and add 250 μL of 0.5% PBS-T.
Aspirate the PBS-T and add another 250 μL of 0.5% PBS-T.
Aspirate and add 250 μL of collagenase buffer and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate and add 250 μL of collagenase mix and incubate for 4 hours at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate the collagenase and add 250 μL of blocking buffer.
Incubate with the blocking buffer for 5 minutes at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate and repeat for a total of two 5 min incubations in the blocking buffer.
Incubate the samples in 250 μL of the primary antibody solution overnight (12–16 h) at 4°C.
Aspirate the primary antibody solution.
Wash with 250 μL of the ‘primary antibody solution’ without the actual antibody.
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Aspirate and repeat for a total of three washes in the ‘primary antibody solution’ (without the antibody).
Add 250 μL of the secondary antibody solution.
Incubate for 2 h at room temperature (20°C–25°C) in the dark.
Harvest worms at day 1 of adulthood and process as described above.
Incubate samples overnight (12-16 hours) in the primary antibody solution without adding the primary antibody.
Incubate samples for 2 hours with goat anti-rabbit secondary antibody at a concentration of 1:500.
Capture images using a Leica confocal microscope with an exposure time of 1 second.
Treat wild-type 1-day adult worms for 6 hours in chloroquine 20 mM.
Harvest treated and untreated worms in parallel.
Incubate harvested worms overnight (12–16 h) in rabbit anti-LGG-1 primary antibody at a concentration of 1:250.
Incubate with goat anti-rabbit secondary antibody for 2 hours at a concentration of 1:500.
Aspirate and wash with 250 μL of the ‘secondary antibody solution’ (without actual antibody).
Incubate for 5 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C).
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature (20°C–25°C) if staining nuclei is desired.
Aspirate the incubation solution and remove the CultureWell silicon gasket.
Clean the slide with a Kimwipe moistened with ethanol (200 proof).
Add a drop of mounting media (e.g., Vectashield SKU:H-1000-10).
Place a coverslip on top and seal it with nail polish.
Proceed to fluorescent imaging.
